detailed_description:
The target video is three separate music-video shots in <Subject 1>, everything alive and moving.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The two men lift another speaker box onto the tower, the bulb strings sway in the evening breeze, the dusk sky deepens, while the camera walks slowly down the street toward them, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>. The hands push the plugs in and the valves glow brighter and flicker, while the camera pushes slowly across the amplifier, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 3>. The hand slides the record out of the sleeve and turns it so the grooves catch the light, while the camera rises slowly over the crate, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
